description:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production
  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines
  • You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way
  • You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact
  • You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer


Who you are

  • You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks
  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture
  • You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it
  • Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer
  • Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI, containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling
  • You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines
  • An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side
  • Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence. More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment
  • German (at least C1) and business-fluent English
  • Willingness to work regularly on-site at client locations
  • A completed degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, business informatics, or a comparable field (Bachelor's or higher)


Who we are

  • Shape the future with AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
  • Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.
  • Take advantage of our Company Bike program and a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership to support your health and wellbeing.
  • Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
  • Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.
  • Thrive in an environment built on trust, ownership, and continuous growth, where your ideas are valued regardless of your role or level of seniority

The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer in the ANR team, you will be primarily abackend engineer with fullstack capabilities (~80% backend / 20% frontend).
